elements.title: World Bank Group Debt Statistics Program Three-Tier Architecture
elements.description: Three boxes run from left to right: Tier 1, DRS, “Granular date foundation,” with a document icon; Tier 2, IDS, “Trusted, transparent statistics,” with a bar chart icon; and Tier 3, IDR, “Actionable knowledge,” with a computer icon. Solid arrows connect Tier 1 to Tier 2 and Tier 2 to Tier 3; a dashed feedback arrow returns from Tier 3 to Tier 1, labeled “Gaps and findings strengthen reporting.” A box below is headed “Debt transparency as a continuous cycle” and describes coordinated action across borrowers, bilateral and multilateral creditors, private lenders, international financial institutions, and other stakeholders.
elements.notes: Source: Original figure for this publication. Note: DRS = Debtor Reporting System; IDR = International Debt Report; IDS = International Debt Statistics.
